capabilities: , Forward content from WeChat and web links
Collect digital assets including articles, files, and media
Organize content using AI digests and transcription
Sync collected content into the Obsidian vault
extras: Requires a running LUMI service instance (lumi.pblc.top) to function.
problem: Users struggle to consolidate and organize digital assets (articles, chats, media) scattered across various platforms into a single knowledge base.

relations.evidence: This plugin talks only to the LUMI service (lumi.pblc.top) that hosts your own content queue.

summary: A cross-platform knowledge asset synchronization tool that uses AI to organize and automatically sync content from WeChat, web, and other sources into the Obsidian vault.
